Bulgaria is workable for trans visitors — an EU member with no traveler-facing restrictions, but one of the EU's most hostile social climates. There is no bathroom law, no border friction for foreign passports, and no criminalisation of gender expression. records.name: Slovakia
records.summary_text:
Slovakia is workable for trans visitors. There are no traveller-facing restrictions: no bathroom law, no border issues under the free-movement rules of the regional union this country belongs to, and legal gender recognition has existed for over 40 years (though medicalised and historically requiring sterilisation). Police protect Pride events.
